## Checklist

- [ ] I added a [change log entry](https://calendaring-sync.readthedocs.io/en/stable/contribute.html#change-log), or the change doesn't need one.
- [ ] I followed the [artificial intelligence policy](https://calendaring-sync.readthedocs.io/en/stable/contribute.html#artificial-intelligence-policy) and disclosed any AI use.
